blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Two motorcycle riders who were not wearing crash helmets died after their vehicle crashed into a concrete roadside barrier in San Francisco, Quezon, on Nov. 1. The 29-year-old male driver and his male back rider were traveling along a winding road in Barangay Nasalaan when the motorcycle suddenly went out of control at around 12:30 p.m., police said in a Nov. 2 report. READ: Quezon road mishaps: 2 motorcyclists dead, 2 hurt The motorcycle slammed into a concrete barrier, killing both riders at the scene, police said.
